name: Troubleshoot wp-env port conflict
query: wp-env start is failing because port 8888 is already in use. How do I fix this?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Identify the port conflict from the error message
Step 2: Suggest using --auto-port flag to find an available port
Step 3: Alternatively, configure a custom port in .wp-env.json
Step 4: If another wp-env instance is running, stop it with wp-env stop
Step 5: Restart with wp-env start --auto-port or updated config
Step 6: Verify with wp-env status to confirm new port
success_criteria: Solution uses --auto-port or custom port config (not killing random processes)
Environment starts successfully on a non-conflicting port
User is informed of the new URL to access WordPress
